Note: SW 0.3.2 - the DFPlayer command sender now follows RecelFA v0.6 instead of GottFA1_PLuS v0.5. Symptom that started this: 0.3.1 ran on the dev_open board, boot info showed 131, and the player stayed silent. The sd card was ruled out (folder 02 with 001.mp3 and up, the same card runs in GottFA1_PLuS). rtl/common/dfplayer_cmd.vhd had been ported in 0.3.0 from N:\Projekte\FPGA System1 (v0.5, 09.2025), which is the older branch. The maintained line is N:\Projekte\FPGA Recel (v0.6, 08.2026) and it carries four hardenings learned in the field that the port did not have. One, complete 10 byte frames INCLUDING the checksum - the RecelFA header says some clone chips insist on it, and this is the prime suspect for the silence. Two, 0x0D sent after the repeat command because some chips only set the mode and do not start playing. Three, half a second of silence between two frames. Four, 5 s instead of 2 s startup delay for slow modules, plus 0x16 stop instead of the player reset 0x0C - the reset sends the player through a second boot with an sd scan, which is exactly when a command gets lost. Implemented by rewriting the fsm: frame_t is 10 bytes with the checksum computed in build, a new st_Gap sits after EVERY frame so there is always a defined pause, and a pending / pending_cmd pair carries the follow up command. Boot sequence is now 0x42 query, 0x16 stop, 0x06 volume, each half a second apart, then 0x17 repeat folder 02 and 0x0D play when the trigger comes up. What was NOT taken from RecelFA is the structure: it shifts a 100 bit register on its own 9600 Hz clock, here work.UART_TX keeps doing the sending in the clk_50 domain, so still one clock domain and nothing for the sdc. 0x11 repeat all stays documented as the fallback if a module cannot handle folders, as a comment, not as a second mode. Comb 4509 -> 4572, Reg 1532 -> 1544, Memory UNCHANGED at 202752, pins UNCHANGED at 85 of 89. Most of the checksum adders fold away because every build call has constant arguments except the one through pending_cmd. Slack 2.484 -> 3.135, better. Warnings unchanged at 4. The comb gap to cyclone_10_dev_open is back to 2 after the 14 at 0.3.1, which supports reading that outlier as constant folding around the version digits and nothing else. HARDWARE CONFIRMED for the first time with this release, on cyclone_10_dev_open on the bench: the DFPlayer actually plays. The four RecelFA hardenings were the difference between silent and playing, so the checksum theory is now more than a theory. Still NOT confirmed is anything that needs a machine - on the bench no switch matrix is attached, every switch reads open, so the outhole trigger stands permanently anyway and is not part of this proof. Evidence on the five outhole switch numbers stands at two levels that must not be mixed up: all five are documented (Manuals\Atari Schalterzuordnungen und Kontakttestcodes.pdf) AND verified against the roms - Atarians 76B4/76F0, Time 2000 732D/7457, Airborne 7298, Space Riders 770E/78EA, Middle Earth 771F, where Airborne and Space Riders use the identical LDAA / BPL wait loop idiom - but only Airborne has ever been exercised on a machine. A rom proof shows the game program treats that address as the outhole, not that the switch is wired there on a given playfield. Note the two numberings while reading the manual: sw_state offset = address - 0x2000 = manual switch number + 15, so the manual says 35/38/41/52 where the fpga says 50/53/56/67. Expected telegrams byte by byte and the roughly 13 to 15 second timeline from power on to the first note are in docs/Background_Music.md chapter 6. Lead variant. These are the SYNTHESIS numbers.
